claim: React Router loaders run per navigation; a successful action automatically revalidates all loader data on the page; shouldRevalidate is the only control. No staleness or cache-invalidation model is described.

claim: Recommended error strategy: QueryCache onError for one-toast-per-failed-query (guarded on query.state.data !== undefined so only background refetches toast), plus throwOnError as a predicate to route 5xx to an error boundary.
quote: const queryClient = new QueryClient({ queryCache: new QueryCache({ onError: (error, query) => { if (query.state.data !== undefined) { toast.error(`Something went wrong: ${error.message}`) } } }) }) ... throwOnError: (error) => error.response?.status >= 500

claim: invalidateQueries supports prefix matching by default, exact: true, and an arbitrary predicate function.

claim: Documented optimistic-update-with-rollback pattern: onMutate cancels in-flight queries, snapshots via getQueryData, writes via setQueryData and returns the snapshot; onError restores it; onSettled invalidates. Current docs pass a context object exposing context.client.
quote: onMutate: async (newTodo, context) => { await context.client.cancelQueries({ queryKey: ['todos'] }); const previousTodos = context.client.getQueryData(['todos']); ... return { previousTodos } }, onError: (err, newTodo, onMutateResult, context) => { context.client.setQueryData(['todos'], onMutateResult.previousTodos) }

claim: Page-based pagination: put the page in the query key and use placeholderData: keepPreviousData so previous data stays visible while the new page loads; isPlaceholderData gates the next-page button.
quote: the data from the last successful fetch is available while new data is being requested, even though the query key has changed

claim: useInfiniteQuery takes initialPageParam and getNextPageParam, exposes fetchNextPage/hasNextPage, returns data.pages plus data.pageParams, and maxPages caps retained pages.
quote: hasNextPage: Boolean that is true when getNextPageParam returns a value other than null or undefined. maxPages: Limits the number of pages retained in query data.

claim: Official testing guidance: wrap in a per-test QueryClientProvider, set retry: false to avoid timeouts on failure tests, and set gcTime: Infinity under Jest to avoid the 'Jest did not exit' warning.

claim: Default retry is 3 attempts with exponential backoff Math.min(1000 * 2 ** attemptIndex, 30000); retry accepts a (failureCount, error) function for custom logic such as not retrying 4xx.
quote: The default formula is: Math.min(1000 * 2 ** attemptIndex, 30000). retry = (failureCount, error) => ... enables custom logic based on why the request failed
